记住：按钮、传感器、反馈是输入（%I），接触器、灯、电磁阀是输出（%Q）。下一课: Remember: Buttons, sensors, and feedback signals are inputs (%I). Contactors, lamps, and solenoid valves are outputs (%Q). The next lesson explains why the stop button normally reads 1.
实训单元里有一台电机、启动和停止两个按钮、一个运行灯。**PLC 里已经装好程序:
The lab cell has a motor, start and stop buttons, and a run indicator lamp. **The PLC program is already loaded**, so you don't need to write any code. Just press the buttons, watch the signals, and answer 5 questions.
**Success looks like this**: Answer all 5 questions correctly to score 100 points.
学 PLC 之前，先分清哪些信号是 PLC 读进来的（输入），哪些是它写出去的（: Before learning PLC programming, first distinguish between signals the PLC reads (inputs) and signals it writes (outputs).
点最左边竖排图标里的「**PLC**」（芯片图标）。左栏下半部分是 **I/O: Click "**PLC**" (the chip icon) in the vertical toolbar on the far left. The lower half of the left pane contains the **I/O Monitor**: inputs %I are listed above outputs %Q.
I/O 监视表实时显示每个信号的值：TRUE 就是 1，FALSE 就是 0。: The I/O Monitor shows each signal's value in real time: TRUE means 1, and FALSE means 0.
看 I/O 表：START 是 FALSE（0），**STOP 却是 TRUE（: Check the I/O table: START is FALSE (0), **but STOP is TRUE (1)**, and M1_RUN is FALSE. Why is STOP 1? The next lesson explains this in detail. For now, just remember it. When you're done, click "Next".
START 是常开按钮，没按时是 0；STOP 是常闭按钮，没按时是 1。: START is a normally open button, so it reads 0 when not pressed. STOP is a normally closed button, so it reads 1 when not pressed.
在操作台上点「**启动**」（按住一会儿再松开）。看 I/O 表里 START: Click "**Start**" on the operator panel (hold it briefly, then release). Watch START change to TRUE in the I/O table, followed by **M1_RUN** and **LAMP_RUN**. The motor starts running.
START 是输入：你按了，PLC 读到 1；M1_RUN 是输出：PLC 算完: START is an input: when you press it, the PLC reads 1. M1_RUN is an output: after executing the logic, the PLC writes 1, the contactor energizes, and the motor runs.
操作台窗口关了的话：选中实训单元，在右边「属性」里点「操作台」。: If the operator panel window is closed, select the lab unit and click "Operator Panel" under "Properties" on the right.
点操作台上的「**停止**」。看 STOP 变成 FALSE，M1_RUN 跟着: Click "**Stop**" on the operator panel. Watch STOP change to FALSE, followed by M1_RUN. The motor stops.
停止按钮按下时信号从 1 变 0，程序看到 0 就断开电机。: When you press the stop button, the signal changes from 1 to 0. When the program sees 0, it switches off the motor.
打开任务面板的「**目标与作答**」，5 道题都选好。不确定的就回操作台再按一次: Open "**Goals & Answers**" in the task panel and select an answer for each of the 5 questions. If you are unsure, return to the operator panel and press the buttons again to check.
点任务面板上绿色的「**提交评分**」。: Click the green "**Submit for Grading**" button in the task panel.
